_comment: Kilo node registry template. Copy to ~/.config/meshforge/kilo_nodes.json and replace the SYNTHETIC anchors with your real lab nodes (MF014: no operator values in the repo copy). Anchors are RADIO identities — never IP addresses (DHCP reassigns them; the loader refuses IP-shaped anchors loudly). Roles: esp32-sensor | nrf-meshtastic | rnode | claw | gateway | other. cadence_s = the node's own telemetry period; status reads DARK after 3 missed cadences. Metric vocabulary (kilo/store.py UNITS): temperature humidity pressure gas_resistance co2 iaq pm25_standard pm10_standard voltage battery_level channel_utilization air_util_tx snr rssi. Nodes whose anchors have no ingest adapter yet (rns, claw) are reported UNKNOWN — declared, visible, never falsely OK or DARK.
